Memory estimates and pin or unpin lifecycle
entries.notes: The shared methods support single-image levels and focused, selected-item, or all-ROI mosaic scopes with explicit memory-risk confirmation.

entries.title: Saved project view CRUD, live capture, and application
Segmentation matching and object preload controls
entries.notes: Preload tasks report progress until the background loader settles and cooperative task cancellation clears the active preload/cache. Segmentation search roots are managed through project.update_metadata.

entries.title: Samplesheet parsing and relative-path import
Samplesheet validation and metadata
entries.notes: Validation returns duplicate IDs, resolved relative paths, source existence, pagination, and metadata columns.

entries.title: Samplesheet project construction and export
Mosaic construction, ROI selection, and shared channel state
entries.notes: Construction is provided by project.rois.open_selected_mosaic and datasets.open_mosaic_samplesheet; channel controls use viewer.channels.* in mosaic mode.

entries.title: Inspect mosaic ROIs, labels, focus, and navigate or fit the focused ROI
Mosaic object loading and memory controls
entries.notes: Selected-ROI loading is task-based and cancellation stops queued scheduling while allowing an in-flight disk read to finish. Shared focused/item/all-ROI memory controls are classified under PERF-03.

entries.title: Inspect local OME-Zarr metadata and discover TIFF, SpatialData, and Xenium sources
entries.notes: Inspection includes typed OME-Zarr and TIFF metadata plus SpatialData and Xenium element discovery. Typed open operations and remote credential contracts are classified in DATA-02 through DATA-05.

entries.title: TIFF and OME-TIFF typed inspection and plane opening
entries.notes: datasets.inspect returns TIFF levels, channels, OME dimensions, physical pixel sizes, and available Z/T extents.

entries.title: Remote HTTP and S3 source and credential contracts
entries.notes: S3 secrets are session-only, never returned by API results, and cleared explicitly. Persistent credential storage is intentionally unsupported.

entries.title: SpatialData discovery and element loading
entries.notes: datasets.inspect owns discovery and returns the typed elements accepted by this method.

entries.title: Xenium discovery, imagery, cells, and transcripts
entries.notes: Callers explicitly choose auto, OME-Zarr, or TIFF imagery and whether cell/transcript archives are attached.

entries.title: CSV, GeoJSON, Parquet, and GeoParquet source lifecycle
entries.notes: Format is inferred from the path; CSV coordinate columns are deterministically inferred and Parquet properties remain lazy.

entries.title: NGFF label discovery and rendering state
Object source loading and property discovery
entries.notes: State and bounded lazy-property access are covered; source load/reload/clear is classified separately in OBJ-04 and DATA-06.

entries.title: Polygon, point, proxy, and selection rendering state
entries.notes: viewer.objects.get_state reports polygon/point mode and counts; style methods control stroke, fill, selection overlay, color-property, and legend overrides.

entries.title: Object reload, clear, and source lifecycle
Simple filter clauses and All or Any logic
entries.notes: The same method accepts typed simple clauses with All/Any logic or a boolean query; viewer.objects.get_filter returns the model and its monotonic revision.

entries.title: Filter revisions across analysis, measurement, and export
entries.notes: All native downstream consumers derive from the same filtered index cache and monotonic filter revision exposed by this method.

entries.title: Filter deep-link and adapter exposure
entries.notes: Filter state can be extracted without mutation; deep_links.generate and the settled deep_links.apply task provide round-trip generation/application.

entries.title: Selection-driven review, analysis, and export
entries.notes: Stable-ID set semantics, filter-driven selection, and primary focus are covered. Named review sets and selection-driven analysis/export are provided by the ANALYSIS and EXPORT families.

entries.title: Histograms, transformations, and thresholds
entries.notes: Histogram reads use the current object filter and support native none/arcsinh transforms with bounded bin counts.

entries.title: Threshold suggestions and selection
Calls, composites, presets, and mappings
Project-linked analysis warmup
entries.notes: Warmup is a task that settles when all available numeric property caches finish.

entries.title: Mean and exact-median polygon intensity measurement
Filtered measurement and generated properties
entries.notes: Measurement configuration/start accepts filtered_only; generated numeric properties immediately enter the shared property/filter/analysis model.

entries.title: GeoParquet export with geometry preservation
CSV, calls, properties, and selection export
entries.notes: All export starts support all, filtered, and selected scopes while preserving source object indices for properties, calls, selections, and WKB geometry.

entries.title: Visible and full-image threshold preview
entries.notes: Whole-image preview retains the native 10-million-pixel interactive safety limit. Start and refresh are task methods because image reads may be slow.

entries.title: Threshold component filtering and polygonization
entries.notes: Apply recomputes the CPU mask using the configured minimum component size before polygonization.

entries.title: Apply threshold preview as editable mask
entries.notes: The apply task identifies the created editable mask layer and polygon count.

entries.title: Mask polygon CRUD, selection, and undo
entries.notes: Layer/polygon CRUD, explicit polygon and vertex selection, and the native undo stack are covered. Polygon indices are scoped to a layer revision and may shift after deletion.

entries.title: Mask GeoJSON import and export
Project mask persistence
entries.notes: Sync updates the in-memory project representation; project.save persists it to disk.

entries.title: Inspect and control native layer visibility, active state, and stack order
entries.notes: Python-supplied external layers remain available through client.layers; native layers use client.native_layers until the high-level union view is stabilized.

entries.title: Set and reset native layer world translations
Inspect, set, and reset channel translation, scale, and rotation
Deep-link parsing, validation, and aliases
Project and ROI resolution and disambiguation
Apply and generate channel, object, legend, filter, and camera state
entries.notes: Apply validates project/ROI resolution before mutation and returns a task that settles after queued application and viewer loading are idle.
